verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials is a fair question for a managed streaming API service like Amazon IVS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents IVS-specific scoped credentials, permission scoping, or agent-specific keys; the CLI region flag and EventBridge rules do not address credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
